help.arcade: Where arcade games go: fbneo is forgiving about romset versions, mame needs exact sets.
help.bgdl: When you leave RomM-o-Cera, the queue keeps going in the background, also while you play.
help.bios: What each system needs, what's missing, and what your RomM can supply.
help.cache: Deletes every cached cover; they download again as you browse.
help.cachelimit: How much space game covers may take. The least recently seen go first.
help.channel: Stable gets tested releases. Nightly also gets builds of the newest changes: fixes sooner, less tested.
help.chd: Turns CD and DVD games (PlayStation, PS2, PSP, Saturn, Dreamcast…) into CHD in the background. Lossless, verified before the original is deleted.
help.chdlowmem: Skips chdman's FLAC codec, which leaks memory on some builds: CD audio comes out a bit bigger, still lossless. Auto turns it on under 4 GB of RAM.
help.chdthreads: CPU threads conversions may use while nothing else runs. Auto leaves some for the menus.
help.checkupdates: Once a day, asks GitHub whether a newer version is out; the request says nothing about you. Off, Updates still checks when you select it.
help.credits: The people and projects RomM-o-Cera is built on or downloads, and their licenses.
help.docs: Point your phone's camera at the code to open the documentation. {A} shows it bigger.
help.hours: Downloads only start inside this window, e.g. overnight; one still running pauses when it closes. Download now in Downloads skips the wait.
help.keepfree: Downloads and conversions never leave less than this free. One that doesn't fit waits for room; smaller ones keep going.
help.manuals: Brings each game's PDF manual from RomM; it opens from the game's menu in EmulationStation.
help.notify: A popup in EmulationStation when background downloads finish.
help.overlap: The next game downloads while one unpacks. Turn it off on slow storage (SD cards, USB sticks).
help.pair: Sign in without typing the token: in RomM open Profile, Client API tokens, press Pair, and type the 8-character code here within a minute. Give each box its own token.
help.ps3decrypt: Decrypts PS3 discs with the disc keys of games you own: put them in bios/ps3keys or RomM's PS3 firmware (none come with the app). A wrong key is never used.
help.ps3folders: Turns PS3 disc images (.iso, zipped or not) into .ps3 folders, the layout RPCS3 installs updates and DLC for. Checked before the image is deleted. Encrypted discs need Decrypt PS3 discs.
help.resetcfg: Puts every setting back to its default, server and token included. The old file is kept as config.json.bad-…, so nothing is lost.
help.rollback: Swaps the previous version back in and restarts the app. The current one is kept, so this can be undone too.
help.rvz: Turns GameCube and Wii images into RVZ, usually 30-60% smaller and lossless; the original is deleted once the copy is verified. Downloads dolphin-tool (about 8 MB) once.
help.sounds: Clicks and chimes while you browse.
help.speed: Caps background downloads while a game runs, so online play and streaming stay smooth.
help.squashfs: Packs Xbox games into squashfs, usually 15-45% smaller, which Batocera opens at launch. Lossless, verified before the original is deleted. Full disc images need Make Xbox images bootable.
help.style: Which symbols the hints show. Auto picks them from the controller's name.
help.swap: Which face button confirms. Batocera's default is the bottom one.
help.test: Asks RomM for its platform list right now and says how many it found.
help.theme: Colours for the whole app. {A} shows every theme, previewed live: {A} keeps one, {B} goes back, {Y} picks its OLED version. Left and right step through them here.
help.themeauto: A PlayStation, Xbox or Nintendo controller shows the theme made for it instead of yours. High contrast and Custom are always kept.
help.tls: Checks your RomM's HTTPS certificate. Turn it off only for a self-signed certificate, or point it at your own CA bundle in config.json.
help.token: A RomM client API token with read access: in RomM, Profile, Client API tokens. {A} edits it.
help.update: Checks GitHub for a newer version, then downloads it, checks it and restarts to install it. Downloads pause meanwhile, and the current version is kept so you can go back.
help.url: Your RomM's address, e.g. https://romm.example.com. {A} edits it. Plain http:// sends the token unencrypted.
help.wua: Turns Wii U discs into .wua for Cemu with the disc keys of games you own: in Cemu's keys.txt, bios/wiiukeys or RomM's Wii U firmware (none come with the app). Checked first; a .wua can't become the disc image again. A disc without its key becomes a .wux.
help.wux: Compresses Wii U disc images (.wud) into .wux for Cemu, often much smaller. Lossless and needs no keys: checked byte for byte before the .wud is deleted. Needs wuatool (about 2 MB), downloaded by itself when needed.
help.xboxboot: xemu boots only a disc's game partition (a full image says "Please insert an Xbox disc"). This keeps just that part and renames .xiso to .iso so EmulationStation lists them.
help.z3ds: Compresses decrypted 3DS games to Azahar's .zcci, often 40-60% smaller. Lossless, verified before the original is deleted; encrypted dumps are left alone.
help.zar: Turns Xbox 360 images into .zar for xenia-canary, often 40-60% smaller. It keeps the game's files, not the whole disc, each checked before the image is deleted. Downloads two small tools once.
